## Community-based surveillance (Indonesian Red Cross)

All scores rest on a single case-study report by the International Federation
of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies and the Indonesian Red Cross (Palang
Merah Indonesia) [@ifrc2021], which includes a published, indicator-based
evaluation (B7 = ●). Volunteers reported priority diseases to a protocol set by
the programme, and community stakeholders were consulted during the assessment
(A2 = ◐), so the case is classed as participatory science. Alerts were
integrated into the national early-warning system and the programme moved to
local government ownership and budget funding, which met both C3 and D1 (●).
The verdict is success. The source was written by the implementing organisation
and has not been checked against an independent evaluation.

  - Score
  - Justification
